dct_description_sm: The goal of this study is to better understand the biogeochemical cycling of dissolved methane in Canadian Arctic seas in the context of Arctic warming. The specific objectives are 1) to map the concentrations of dissolved methane, 2) to estimate the air-sea fluxes of methane, 3) to evaluate the role of water mass circulation in controlling methane distributions, 3) to identify potential methane hotspots (e.g. methane seepages), and 4) to estimate the production and consumption rates of methane.
dct_title_s: Dissolved methane in the Baffin Bay, Canadian Arctic archipelago, and Beaufort Sea
